name: Palomero (Spain)
description: Quartered white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Palomero (a cross of Saint James on red above a chequy field).
history: Municipal flag of Palomero; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Palomero arms — cross of Saint James above chequy
